skill.name: scanlume-ocr-api
skill.description: Call the Scanlume OCR API for local image files, screenshots, and image-based tables using simple or formatted modes. It builds base64 data URLs, sends authenticated requests, and returns text, Markdown, HTML, preview, or structured OCR fields.
skill.summary: Extract text and table-aware OCR output from images through the Scanlume API.
skill.author: daanaagua

security_audit.summary: Review found a legitimate OCR integration that sends local image data to the Scanlume API and handles a bearer API key. Most Markdown backtick findings are false positives, but the helper has real network, secret-handling, and command-execution risk. The main added concern is that an overridden base URL can receive the Authorization header.

remediation.issue: API key can be sent to an overridden base URL.
remediation.suggestion: Restrict outbound requests to the official Scanlume API host, or require explicit confirmation for any override.

remediation.issue: API key can be supplied through a command-line argument.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer environment variables or a secret store, and avoid placing API keys in prompts, shell history, or logs.

remediation.issue: Local image content is uploaded to an external OCR service.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users before sending sensitive screenshots or documents outside the local environment.

remediation.issue: Skill instructions include helper command execution.
remediation.suggestion: Document safe argument handling and avoid shell interpolation for user-provided file paths.

semantic_findings.description: The helper accepts an explicit or environment-provided base URL and sends Authorization bearer credentials to that computed endpoint. A malicious invocation could redirect the Scanlume API key to an untrusted server.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code directly combines base URL override support with bearer-token request construction, which is a clear credential redirection risk.

content.value_statement: Teams often need reliable OCR for screenshots, receipts, and image-based tables. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Scanlume API calls and structured OCR outputs.
actual_capabilities: Calls the Scanlume public image OCR endpoint for local image files and screenshots.
Builds full base64 data URLs from local image files before submission.
Selects simple or formatted OCR modes based on the requested output.
Renders text, Markdown, HTML, preview, or JSON response fields from Scanlume responses.
Guides parsing of formatted OCR blocks and table summary fields.
limitations: The public helper rejects PDFs because the public PDF API is beta-gated.
A valid Scanlume API key is required through the environment or command line.
Image contents are sent to the external Scanlume API for OCR processing.
The documented public API does not support multipart upload or remote file URLs.

use_cases.title: Convert Screenshots to Text
use_cases.description: Extract plain text from interface screenshots for notes, support tickets, or QA records.

use_cases.title: Recover Tables from Images
use_cases.description: Use formatted OCR to preserve table structure from receipts, reports, or captured spreadsheets.

use_cases.title: Automate OCR API Calls
use_cases.description: Prepare data URLs, call the Scanlume endpoint, and return the best response field for downstream work.

prompt_templates.title: Extract Plain Text
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner OCR request for a local image.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Scanlume OCR on this local image and return only the extracted plain text. Use simple mode unless structure is needed.

prompt_templates.title: Preserve Table Structure
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for an image-based table.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use formatted Scanlume OCR on this table image. Return a clean table summary and note any uncertain cells.

prompt_templates.title: Choose the Best Output
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request with unknown layout complexity.
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect the image goal, choose simple or formatted OCR, and explain the selected mode before returning the final output.

prompt_templates.title: Build an OCR Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a repeatable Scanlume OCR workflow for a folder of screenshots. Include mode choice, output field selection, and error handling guidance.

output_examples.input: A screenshot of a receipt with item names, prices, and totals.
output_examples.output: A clean text extraction with line items, subtotal, tax, total, and unclear fields called out.

output_examples.input: An image of a small sales table with grouped rows.
output_examples.output: A structured table summary with columns, row groups, record counts, and any notes from the formatted OCR response.

output_examples.input: A product settings screenshot that contains headings and paragraphs.
output_examples.output: A Markdown-ready document that preserves headings, paragraphs, and readable order.

best_practices: Use formatted mode when layout, headings, or tables matter.
Use environment-based secrets instead of passing API keys directly in prompts.
Confirm user consent before sending sensitive images to the external OCR API.
anti_patterns: Do not claim public PDF OCR API support for this helper.
Do not send private screenshots unless the user accepts external processing.
Do not override the API base URL unless the endpoint is trusted.

faq.question: What image types does this skill target?
faq.answer: It targets local screenshots, JPG files, PNG files, and other image files with an inferred MIME type.

faq.question: Does it support PDF OCR?
faq.answer: No. The helper blocks PDFs because the public Scanlume PDF API is not generally available.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The generated metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: What is the difference between simple and formatted mode?
faq.answer: Simple mode returns raw text. Formatted mode preserves structure, Markdown, HTML, blocks, and table summary fields.

faq.question: Does the skill need an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. The helper requires a Scanlume API key through the environment or an explicit argument.

faq.question: Can it OCR remote file URLs?
faq.answer: No. The documented public API expects a full base64 data URL, not a remote file URL.
